finite bounds.entry channel: 20 seconds; independently wakeable by explicit Entry::Cancel.
finite bounds.hold: One absolute monotonic deadline entered+1700ms; recv_timeout waits remaining duration and explicit cancel wakes immediately; not renewed.
finite bounds.ring release: 30-second finite receive; release/cancel channels wake it.
finite bounds.existing ring loop: Original5ms receive and nonblocking bus publication; finite final request drain with no later test request until join.
finite bounds.outer: Reviewed f40 one owned process group,120-second exact-case watchdog plus bounded TERM/KILL/wait. This bounds blocking Rust joins if OS I/O stalls.
finite bounds.limits: Rust JoinHandle::join has no intrinsic timeout; no claim Drop always finishes under a stuck kernel or forced process kill. Missing receipt, cancellation, errors or residual group invalidates the observation.
